case: Malformed DuckDB script tail fails closed across editor consumers
contract: DuckDB scripts use the existing PostgreSQL-style script lexer, matching DuckDB documented PostgreSQL-like syntax and dollar-quoted strings.
An unterminated quoted tail reports a planner diagnostic and blocks whole-script execution while the valid prefix remains cursor-selectable.
The malformed tail is not cursor-selectable; parameter extraction exposes only the safe-prefix parameter and retains the tail.
Formatting retains the malformed tail and the formatted script remains diagnosed.
Agent policy classifies the script as unparseable/write and denies it with fail_closed_unparseable.
limits: This validates script lexical consumers and policy only; it does not execute DuckDB SQL or close other dialect, value-type, or installed-editor acceptance.
